description: Source code implementing functions to interface with libRocket's datagrids for displaying tabulated information, including data source registration, row addition, modification, removal, and table clearing.

methods.name: Rocket_RegisterDataSource
methods.description: Registers a new data source with the given name.

methods.name: FindDataSource
methods.description: Finds and returns a pointer to the data source with the specified name.

methods.name: Rocket_DSAddRow
methods.description: Adds a row to the specified data source and table.

methods.name: Rocket_DSChangeRow
methods.description: Changes a specific row in the specified data source and table.

methods.name: Rocket_DSRemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a row from the specified data source and table.

methods.name: Rocket_DSClearTable
methods.description: Clears all rows from the specified table in the data source.
